description: Recurring eCPM patterns for top publishers across 2024-2025
methodology: Weekly eCPM computed from real parquet data. Patterns identified where same directional behavior (above/below yearly average) occurs in both 2024 and 2025 for consecutive weeks (min 3). Consistency score = Pearson correlation of weekly delta% vectors between the two years.

patterns.label: Q1 Start Premium
patterns.rationale: eCPM consistently trends above the yearly average during this period (+6.0% in 2024, +16.8% in 2025), likely driven by post-holiday budget resets and advertiser Q1 planning cycles. This recurring pattern across both years suggests a structural seasonal effect.
